description: Android repos: baseline plus compileSdk tracking.

android-api-level.description: Latest released Android API level, from the endoflife.date android feed.

customManagers.description: Keep compileSdk on the latest released API level so androidx bumps do not fail checkAarMetadata. Matches both Kotlin DSL (compileSdk = 37) and Groovy (compileSdk 37). Deliberately does not match minSdk or targetSdk: those change device compatibility and runtime behavior, and are a human decision.

packageRules.description: compileSdk bumps get a human look, never automerge
